summary: Learn to assess database workloads, design ERDs and document architecture decisions. Explore the five-day foundation course and course outline.
lede: Database architecture training helps data professionals turn application requirements into database structures that fit workloads and design constraints. It covers mapping entities and relationships, reviewing normalization and integrity rules, and comparing OLTP and OLAP needs with transaction and availability choices. Participants also document security and lifecycle considerations in an architecture decision record and phased roadmap for technical and stakeholder review.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who shape data structures, application interfaces, or platform decisions and need to explain the consequences of database design choices.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with database tables, records, and primary keys is expected. Coding or programming is not required.
